lead.zh: 民主党横扫国会后，美股迎来一年半来最强单日，油价重挫；伊朗称美国选民拒绝了战争；第九届进博会今日开幕。
lead.en: After Democrats swept Congress, the Dow had its best day in 18 months as oil plunged; Iran says US voters rejected the war; the 9th CIIE opens in Shanghai today.

title.zh: 腾讯发布混元 Hy4 正式版，新增视觉与电脑操作能力
title.en: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use

summary.zh: 腾讯 11 月 4 日发布 770B 参数的混元 Hy4 正式版，首次加入视觉理解和电脑操作能力，已上线元宝、CodeBuddy 等产品；模型权重和系统卡称将在几天内开源。
summary.en: Tencent released the production version of Hy4, a 770B-parameter MoE model that adds visual understanding and computer use for the first time. It is live in Yuanbao, CodeBuddy and Tencent Cloud; weights and system cards are promised in the coming days.

body.zh:
腾讯称，Hy4 在指令遵循、长文本理解和长程智能体任务上较 8 月预览版明显提升，并首次支持命令行与图形界面的电脑操作。

- 已接入元宝、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy、企业微信助手、ima 和腾讯云 TokenHub，也可通过 OpenRouter 等第三方调用。
- 定价与预览版相同：每百万输入 token 约 0.90 美元、输出约 2.70 美元，TokenHub 年底前五折。
- 目前只能租用、不能自部署：权重和系统卡尚未发布，可下载的仍是 8 月的 Apache 2.0 预览版。
body.en:
Tencent says Hy4 improves on the August preview in instruction following, long-document understanding and long-horizon agent work, and adds command-line and GUI computer use.

- Live in Yuanbao, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, WeCom's assistant, ima and Tencent Cloud TokenHub, and via third-party routers such as OpenRouter.
- Pricing is unchanged at roughly $0.90 per million input tokens and $2.70 per million output tokens, with a 50% TokenHub discount through Dec 31.
- You can rent it but not self-host it yet: weights and system cards are still pending ([NPDev](https://npdev.ai/news/ai/2026-11-04)).

title.zh: Meta 收购 AI 编程初创公司 Conductor
title.en: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor

summary.zh: Meta 收购了 Conductor，这家 2024 年成立的公司让开发者在并行工作区里同时调度多个编程智能体，智能体本身来自 Anthropic、OpenAI 等大模型公司。
summary.en: Meta has bought Conductor, a 2024 startup that lets developers run multiple coding agents in parallel workspaces. The agents themselves come from labs like Anthropic and OpenAI.

title.zh: OpenAI 收购 Pierre 加码 Codex；称 ChatGPT 周活 12 亿
title.en: OpenAI buys Pierre for Codex, says ChatGPT has 1.2B weekly users

summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布收购 Pierre Computer Company，扩充 Codex 的写代码、读代码和审代码工具；同时称 ChatGPT 周活达 12 亿，类搜索查询约相当于谷歌搜索量的 20%（自家估算）。
summary.en: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex's tools for building, understanding and reviewing code. It also said ChatGPT has 1.2B weekly users and search-like queries equal about 20% of Google's volume, by its own estimate.

title.zh: 伊朗称美国选民「对战争说不」，哈梅内伊警告敌意不会改变
title.en: Iran hails midterm rebuke; Khamenei says US hostility won't end

summary.zh: 伊朗官员把民主党横扫国会解读为美国人拒绝伊朗战争，但最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊称期待美国政策转向是「严重错误」。特朗普承认战争和油价拖累了共和党，并说战争「会在我想结束的时候结束」。
summary.en: Iranian officials framed the Democratic sweep as Americans rejecting the war, but Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said anyone expecting a US policy shift is "seriously mistaken." Trump admitted the war and fuel prices hurt Republicans but said it will end "when I want."

body.zh:
美伊战事推高美国油价和物价，是共和党在周二中期选举中失去参众两院的重要原因。德黑兰谈判代表称美国人投出了「对战争说不」的一票。

- 哈梅内伊则称，任何期待美国对伊政策转变的人都「严重错误」。
- 分析人士预计伊朗立场会更强硬而非软化，美方进一步空袭的可能仍在（[RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-midterm-election-war-talks/33890496.html)）。
- 特朗普承认战争影响了选情，但表示他会再做同样决定，并称没说过战争会在选举后立刻结束。
body.en:
Anger over war-driven fuel and grocery prices helped Democrats take both chambers on Tuesday. Tehran's negotiators said Americans voted "no to war."

- Khamenei said anyone expecting a change in US policy is "seriously mistaken" ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/4/iran-hails-us-voters-rejecting-war-while-khamenei-warns-hostility-wont-end)).
- Analysts expect Iran to harden rather than soften, and further US strikes remain possible ([RFE/RL](https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-midterm-election-war-talks/33890496.html)).
- Trump acknowledged the war hurt his party but said he would do it again, and that it will end when he wants ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/midterm-elections-democrats-republicans-trump-b1d26390b7ed7968435089be6d3bf612)).

title.zh: 俄军轰炸乌克兰学校致 40 死，阿布扎比和谈前夕基辅断电
title.en: Russian strike on Ukrainian school kills 40 ahead of Abu Dhabi talks

summary.zh: 泽连斯基称，俄军周一轰炸扎波罗热州一所用作救援物资发放点的学校，死亡人数升至 40 人，另有 30 多人可能仍被埋。周三俄军夜袭致基辅大面积断电断水；美俄乌三方定于 11 月 10–11 日在阿布扎比会谈。
summary.en: Zelenskyy said the death toll from Monday's bombing of a school used as an aid hub in Zaporizhzhia has reached 40, with 30-plus possibly still under rubble. Overnight strikes cut power and water in Kyiv; US-brokered talks are set for Abu Dhabi on Nov 10-11.

title.zh: 道指暴涨 1569 点创一年半最佳单日，油价跌超 8%
title.en: Dow jumps 1,569 points, best day in 18 months, as oil sinks 8%

summary.zh: 民主党拿下国会、特朗普接受选举结果，消除了政治不确定性。道指涨 3.03% 至 53356.12 点，标普 500 涨 1.58%，纳指涨 1.44%；美油和布伦特原油均跌超 8%，但 AI 基建股逆势下挫。
summary.en: With Democrats taking Congress and Trump accepting the result, the Dow rose 3.03% to 53,356.12, the S&P 500 1.58% and the Nasdaq 1.44%. US crude and Brent fell more than 8%, while AI infrastructure stocks slid.

body.zh:
这是道指自 2025 年 4 月 9 日（特朗普宣布暂停对等关税）以来最好的单日表现，并重回 53000 点上方。

- 副总统万斯把败选归咎于伊朗战争后，油价加速下跌，市场押注战争更早结束；能源板块跌 4.77%，可选消费和金融分别涨 4.27% 和 3.46%。
- 微软、亚马逊涨超 6%，苹果涨超 5%；英伟达跌约 3%，CoreWeave 跌超 9%，美光、希捷等存储股跌 7% 以上。
- 新任得州州长希诺霍萨承诺对数据中心建设实施暂停令，加重了对 AI 基建的担忧（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)）。
body.en:
It was the Dow's best day since April 9, 2025, when Trump paused his reciprocal tariffs, and it closed back above 53,000.

- Oil fell faster after Vice President JD Vance blamed the Iran war for the losses; energy lost 4.77% while consumer discretionary and financials rose 4.27% and 3.46% ([Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20261105/906833b4c13b440193fa7167969dc792/c.html)).
- Microsoft and Amazon rose more than 6% and Apple more than 5%; Nvidia fell about 3% and CoreWeave more than 9%.
- Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa's pledged moratorium on data centers added to AI build-out worries ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)).

title.zh: 央行下调股票回购增持再贷款利率至 1%
title.en: PBOC cuts stock buyback relending rate to 1%

summary.zh: 央行自 11 月 4 日起将股票回购增持再贷款利率下调 0.25 个百分点至 1%，银行已申请额度超 2000 亿元；今天还将开展 3000 亿元 3 个月期买断式逆回购。
summary.en: The PBOC cut the rate on its stock buyback relending facility by 0.25 point to 1% from Nov 4; banks have applied for more than 200B yuan. It also runs a 300B-yuan, 3-month outright reverse repo today.

body.zh:
央行称此举旨在维护资本市场平稳运行。该再贷款支持 21 家全国性银行和 5 家系统重要性城商行，支持比例 100%、期限 1 年，可展期。

- 11 月 2 日座谈会后，银行报送的再贷款额度申请已超 2000 亿元，央行表示将充分满足需求。
- 央行第三批互换便利（SFISF）操作落地，24 家券商中标，已披露金额合计超 400 亿元，将用于增持股票和股票 ETF（财联社）。
- 另有消息称部分券商收到放慢 IPO 节奏的窗口指导，业内认为是收紧而非「一刀切」暂停。

title.zh: 第九届进博会今日在上海开幕，展览面积创新高
title.en: 9th China International Import Expo opens in Shanghai

summary.zh: 第九届中国国际进口博览会 11 月 5 日开幕，4142 家境外企业参展，展览面积首次突破 44 万平方米，全球首发、亚洲首秀、中国首展的代表性展品超过 480 件，均创历届新高。
summary.en: The 9th CIIE opens in Shanghai on Nov 5 with 4,142 overseas exhibitors, more than 440,000 square meters of space and over 480 global, Asian or China debut products, all records.

title.zh: 五部门印发全面节约方案：2030 年单位 GDP 能耗降约 10%
title.en: China sets 2030 targets for energy, water and land efficiency

summary.zh: 发改委等五部门印发《实施全面节约战略行动方案》，提出到 2030 年单位 GDP 能耗、用水量、建设用地面积较 2025 年分别下降约 10%、10%、15%，主要再生资源年循环利用量达 5.1 亿吨。
summary.en: Five agencies led by the NDRC issued a conservation plan targeting cuts of about 10% in energy use, 10% in water use and 15% in construction land per unit of GDP by 2030 versus 2025, and 510M tonnes of recycled resources a year.

title.zh: 华为、阿里、腾讯等 20 家单位发布《智能体发展自律公约》
title.en: Huawei, Alibaba, Tencent and others sign AI agent self-regulation pact

summary.zh: 中国信通院联合华为、阿里、腾讯、小米等 20 家单位发布《智能体发展自律公约》，提出共建智能体互联基础设施，推进注册解析、能力发现、协议互认等技术与标准。
summary.en: CAICT and 20 organizations including Huawei, Alibaba, Tencent and Xiaomi issued a self-regulation pact for AI agents, pledging shared interconnection infrastructure and standards for agent registration, discovery and protocol compatibility.

title.zh: OpenAI 称 AI 流水线发现并验证 948 个 Linux 提权漏洞
title.en: OpenAI says AI pipeline found and exploited 948 Linux LPEs

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布报告称，其自主漏洞发现流水线在一次运行中复现 1724 个漏洞，并生成 948 个可让普通用户拿到 root 的本地提权利用，还附带候选补丁；API 成本约 121 万美元。
summary.en: OpenAI said its autonomous vuln pipeline reproduced 1,724 findings and produced 948 working local privilege-escalation exploits that could give an unprivileged user root, plus candidate patches, at about $1.21M in API cost.

body.zh:
OpenAI 称该流水线覆盖发现、动态验证、可利用性评估和补丁生成，核心是即将发布的网络安全模型；扫描对象是一台标准桌面发行版配置的虚拟机，而非特意弱化的靶机。

- 中期 10 月那次运行分析了约 280 万行代码（约内核 7%），候选发现 2308 个，动态复现率约 74.7%。
- 公司表示正按 Linux 社区建议优先上报关键漏洞，并与 Patch the Planet 伙伴合作逐步提交其余补丁（[OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/)）。
- 同期对 hardened kernelCTF 环境的试跑还拿到 21 个 LPE；OpenAI 认为自动补丁生成对跟上发现速度越来越关键。
body.en:
OpenAI says the pipeline covers discovery, dynamic validation, exploitability assessment and patch generation, powered by an upcoming cyber model, against stock desktop VMs rather than softened targets.

- A mid-October run audited about 2.8M lines (~7% of the kernel), produced 2,308 candidates and reproduced ~74.7% of them.
- Critical reports are going out first with Patch the Planet partners ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/)).
- A hardened kernelCTF-style run yielded 21 LPEs; OpenAI argues automated patching is essential as discovery scales.

title.zh: 月之暗面按承诺开源 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重
title.en: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights as promised

summary.zh: 月之暗面在 Hugging Face 放出 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重：约 2.8 万亿总参数、约 1040 亿激活的 MoE，上下文约 100 万 token；权重约 1.56 TB，华为 Ascend 等已宣布推理支持。
summary.en: Moonshot AI posted Kimi K3.1 Pro weights on Hugging Face: a ~2.8T-parameter MoE with ~104B active and about a 1M-token context. The dump is ~1.56 TB; Huawei Ascend and others announced inference support.

body.zh:
K3.1 Pro 在 Kimi K3 基础上加强了编程、三维创作、金融研究和长程智能体任务的强化学习，此前已通过 App 与 API 可用。

- 开源兑现了 10 月上线时的权重承诺；多数用户仍会走云端或托管推理。
- 华为称通过 vLLM Ascend 与 SGLang 覆盖 Atlas A3、昇腾 950 等（[TechNode](https://technode.com/2026/11/05/moonshot-ai-releases-kimi-k3-1-pro-model-weights/)）。
body.en:
K3.1 Pro builds on Kimi K3 with more RL for coding, 3D work, financial research and long agent tasks; it was already on apps and the API.

- The drop fulfills Moonshot’s October weight pledge; most users will still use hosted inference.
- Huawei said vLLM Ascend and SGLang cover Atlas A3 and Ascend 950 ([TechNode](https://technode.com/2026/11/05/moonshot-ai-releases-kimi-k3-1-pro-model-weights/)).

title.zh: Apple Intelligence 中国大陆开发者测试启动，接入阿里通义千问
title.en: Apple Intelligence China developer beta uses Alibaba’s Qwen

summary.zh: 苹果于北京时间 11 月 4 日随 iOS 27.3 开发者测试版在中国大陆开启 Apple Intelligence；写作工具、实时翻译、视觉智能等接入阿里通义千问，面向兼容 iPhone，计划 12 月随正式版对公众开放。
summary.en: Apple started Apple Intelligence testing in mainland China with the iOS 27.3 developer beta on Nov 4 Beijing time. Writing Tools, Live Translation and Visual Intelligence use Alibaba’s Qwen; public rollout is planned with iOS 27.3 in December.

title.zh: 伊朗称霍尔木兹「非法航道」两艘油轮与拖船起火
title.en: Iran says two tankers and a tug caught fire on Hormuz ‘illegal’ route

summary.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队 11 月 5 日称，前夜有两艘超级油轮和一艘拖船在霍尔木兹海峡南部「非法未经授权」航道起火；其中一艘触雷起火，拖船救火时亦起火。
summary.en: Iran’s IRGC said on Nov 5 that two supertankers and a tug caught fire overnight on an “illegal and unauthorized” southern route in the Strait of Hormuz; one hit naval mines, and the tug burned while assisting.

body.zh:
革命卫队还称电子战部队控制并迫降了两架「入侵」廉价无人攻击机，并指责美国诱使船只走布雷航道、推高盟友保险成本。

- 伊朗自 2 月 28 日起收紧海峡管控，禁止与以色列、美国有关联的船只安全通过。
- 此事发生在美中期选举后、市场押注冲突降温、油价大跌之际（[新华社](https://english.news.cn/20261105/91ea9945c5ee43478e5e4b22e1966b61/c.html)）。
body.en:
The IRGC also said its electronic-warfare unit seized two “invading” low-cost attack drones and blamed Washington for luring ships into a mined lane and hiking allies’ insurance bills.

- Iran has barred safe passage for Israel- and US-linked vessels since Feb 28.
- The fires come as markets bet on de-escalation after the US midterms and oil plunged ([Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20261105/91ea9945c5ee43478e5e4b22e1966b61/c.html)).

title.zh: 中期惨败后特朗普伊朗选项两难：再打、谈和或「绞杀」
title.en: After midterm rout, Trump faces strike, deal or ‘strangle’ on Iran

summary.zh: Axios 称美军正收尾可能重启对伊大规模作战的准备并向中东增派力量，同时卡塔尔斡旋草案；万斯公开把败选归咎于战争，特朗普承认油价冲击但称「会在我想结束时结束」。
summary.en: Axios reports the US military is finishing prep for a possible return to major Iran combat while Qatar floats a draft deal. Vance publicly blamed the war for the losses; Trump agreed gas prices hurt but said it ends “whenever I want.”

body.zh:
幕僚概括三条路：恢复空袭（政治上极不受欢迎）、谈出协议（伊朗或抬价）、以及用封锁加制裁「绞杀」拖时间。

- 准备增兵不等于已授权打击；卡塔尔方面在选前就问过美方若败选怎么办，得到的答复是「先看选举」。
- 德黑兰庆祝选情被部分外交官视为可能刺激特朗普再动手（[Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/05/trump-iran-war-midterm-defeat-bad-options)）。
body.en:
Aides sketch three paths: resume strikes (politically toxic), negotiate (Iran may raise demands), or “strangle” via blockade and sanctions.

- Force movements do not mean strikes are authorized; Qatari mediators were told before the vote to wait for results.
- Iranian gloating may, some diplomats warn, make Trump more likely to hit back ([Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/05/trump-iran-war-midterm-defeat-bad-options)).

title.zh: 韩股跌超 5%、日经下挫，全球抛售 AI 与数据中心相关股
title.en: Kospi sinks over 5% as investors dump AI and data-center stocks

summary.zh: 民主党中期胜利后，市场押注数据中心监管趋严：韩国综指跌逾 5%，日经 225 跌近 2%；美股期货分化，英伟达等芯片与 CoreWeave 等「新云」继续承压，油价亦走低。
summary.en: After the Democratic midterm win, bets on tighter data-center rules hit Asia: South Korea’s Kospi fell more than 5% and Japan’s Nikkei nearly 2%. US futures were mixed as Nvidia and neocloud names like CoreWeave stayed under pressure; oil also fell.

body.zh:
这是对周三美股「蓝潮」救济行情的延续：道指大涨时 AI 基建股已逆势下跌，周四亚洲半导体与电力相关股跟跌。

- 得州等地反数据中心选情与新州长拟议的建设暂停令，加重了对产能扩张的担忧（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/ai-data-centers-midterms-capacity.html)）。
- 资金更多转向已有现金与算力的超大规模云厂商，而非高杠杆「新云」（[美联社](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-midterm-oil-trump-7ee9c212805aa5e70cf34d25aab7a36e)）。
body.en:
It extends Wednesday’s US session, when the Dow surged but AI infrastructure stocks fell. Thursday’s Asian chip and power names followed lower.

- Anti–data-center ballot wins and Texas’s pledged construction pause deepened build-out fears ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/ai-data-centers-midterms-capacity.html)).
- Money rotated toward cash-rich hyperscalers over leveraged neoclouds ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-midterm-oil-trump-7ee9c212805aa5e70cf34d25aab7a36e)).

title.zh: 中期后油价续跌：市场押注美伊冲突降温
title.en: Oil keeps falling as markets bet on US-Iran de-escalation

summary.zh: 民主党拿下国会后，交易员押注外交优先于再开战：美油与布伦特在周三跌超 8% 后继续承压；霍尔木兹油轮起火消息未能扭转整体的降温押注。
summary.en: With Democrats holding Congress, traders keep betting diplomacy over renewed strikes: US crude and Brent stayed soft after Wednesday’s >8% drop, and Hormuz tanker fires did not reverse the de-escalation trade.

title.zh: 百度开源文心 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base：2800 亿 MoE 基座
title.en: Baidu open-sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B MoE checkpoint

summary.zh: 百度 11 月 5 日放出 ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base：总参 2800 亿、每 token 激活约 140 亿的稀疏 MoE 预训练基座，供微调与研究；许可排除欧盟、英国和韩国，超 5000 万美元相关营收需单独授权。
summary.en: Baidu released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base on Nov 5: a 280B-parameter sparse MoE pretrain (≈14B active) for fine-tuning and research. The license excludes the EU, UK and South Korea and needs Baidu’s OK above $50M related revenue.

body.zh:
该检查点止于预训练，后训练版「文心 5.5 Flash」另行发布；语料约 33.5 万亿 token，推理支持最长约 100 万 token。

- 自家评测称 MMLU 约 93.3、HumanEval+ 约 82.3，但 FullStackBench 等不及部分竞品基座。
- 协议禁止用其输出去改进无关模型，限制蒸馏与合成数据路径（[Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/baidu-releases-ernie-5-5-flash-base-for-further-training/)）。
body.en:
The checkpoint stops at pre-training; a post-trained ERNIE 5.5 Flash is promised later. Training used ~33.5T tokens; inference supports up to about 1M tokens.

- Baidu’s harness cites ~93.3 MMLU and ~82.3 HumanEval+, with mixed results elsewhere.
- The license bars using outputs to improve unrelated models, limiting distillation paths ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/baidu-releases-ernie-5-5-flash-base-for-further-training/)).

title.zh: 第 140 届广交会闭幕：境外采购商 35.2 万创新高
title.en: 140th Canton Fair closes with record 352,000 overseas buyers

summary.zh: 中国对外贸易中心称，10 月 15 日至 11 月 4 日举行的第 140 届广交会吸引 219 个国家和地区的 35.2 万名境外采购商，同比增长 12.2%；现场意向出口成交 267.5 亿美元。
summary.en: China’s Foreign Trade Centre said the 140th Canton Fair (Oct 15–Nov 4) drew 352,000 overseas buyers from 219 countries and regions, up 12.2%, with $26.75B in on-site intended export deals.

body.zh:
欧盟、美国、共建「一带一路」国家采购商分别增长 38.2%、22.2%、16.6%；专业采购商占比超 75%。

- 现场新品、人工智能产品分别增长 8%、14.1%；绿色展品占比 26%。
- 超 3.2 万家企业携 488 万件展品参展，近两成企业开展对外投资（[新华网](https://www.news.cn/20261105/0171f534a6314b86bc1e775e47c8936b/c.html)）。
body.en:
Buyers from the EU, the US and Belt and Road countries rose 38.2%, 22.2% and 16.6%; professionals were over 75% of attendees.

- New products and AI exhibits rose 8% and 14.1%; green exhibits were 26% of the floor.
- More than 32,000 firms showed 4.88M items; nearly 20% said they are investing abroad ([Xinhua](https://www.news.cn/20261105/0171f534a6314b86bc1e775e47c8936b/c.html)).
